title: identifierQuery client: map 404 to 'not found' rather than an error (judgment call)
description: Haven answers identifierQuery for an unknown handle with a bare 404 (DIV-4, mimid-1wgh.46.6.3; seen live on mimi.havenmessenger.com 2026-11-14). mimid's PeerClient returns PeerError::Rejected. Consider mapping a 404 on identifierQuery to an empty or not-found result at the client layer, with a logged divergence, as with the keyMaterial leniency in the sibling bead under 46.1.7. A bare 200 with an empty body stays an error. Decide before implementing; this is lower value than the keyMaterial case.
close_reason: Haven now answers with an IdentifierResponse; mimid reads a 404 carrying notFound as that answer (commit 409c246)
